# The working life of Médousa: from the myths to the modern trades
If the stories are true in the way that matters, they should show up in the world without being invoked. **Médousa** shows up constantly.

Médousa's myth is unusual because it has a before and after. She was not always a monster. The story of her transformation makes her both victim and threat.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **3 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Médousa
- **Pantheon:** Greek
- **Domain of influence:** Gorgon, Guardian
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Technology & Innovation · Culture & Entertainment · Commerce & Governance
- **Strongest seat:** Cybersecurity & Digital Protection
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 149 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**From Maiden to Monster.** In Ovid's Metamorphoses (4. 790–803), Médousa was a maiden famed for her beauty and above all for her hair. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**Perseus and the Head.** Perseus, sent by Polydectes to fetch the Gorgon's head, used Athena's polished shield as a mirror to approach Médousa without looking directly at her.  While she slept, he struck off her head with a sickle given by Hermês. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Cybersecurity & Digital Protection

*Threat defense, authentication, and digital trust. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*The guardian whose gaze turns attackers to stone; her name already fronts security products.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Gaming, Fantasy & Entertainment IP

*Video games, streaming franchises, and fantasy worlds. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The gaze mechanic every player remembers.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Insurance & Protection Services

*Insurance, assurance, and risk protection. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The guardian face on the shield; apotropaic protection.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Médousa's myth is unusual because it has a before and after. The age changed. The work did not.

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. ## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in cybersecurity & digital protection, gaming, fantasy & entertainment ip, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/medousa/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
